steps: Saved renamed state-table interface identifies missing and undeclared parameters. Explicit default filling preserves old values; cancelling leaves both editor and author tree untouched.

Three-language 390px interface and rename controls preserve the selected target. Explicit rename retains the old clip UUID; missing-slot fill and the existing clip picker compose in one binding, followed by full-source review and an unsaved draft.
Explicit repair applies only to the current behavior draft. Ordinary Save changes only that manifest, preserving script source, other bindings, identities and registrations.

Real GUI planning, build and Godot run execute initial idle → event strike → one natural completion → looped idle using the exact behavior parameters repaired and saved in the GUI. Separate completion and command panels display actual frozen histories; three languages at390px retain search and have no horizontal overflow.
Runtime execution and observation leave all author files unchanged after the deliberate behavior manifest save.

en.title: Natural animation completions
en.text:
Natural animation completionsRead-only records of non-looping animations reaching their end naturally. Stopping, seeking to the end and loop boundaries do not produce completion notifications. History remains across scenes and resets on a new run.
    Handled means the synchronous callback succeeded; it does not confirm that subsequent animation commands executed. Skipped may result from unsubscribing, leaving the scene or a new animation command, and does not mean the subscription is permanently removed.

ja.title: アニメーション自然終了の記録
ja.text:
アニメーション自然終了の記録非ループアニメーションが自然に末尾へ到達した記録です。停止、末尾へのシーク、ループ境界では完了通知は発生しません。シーン切り替え後も記録を保持し、再実行時に消去します。
    処理済みは同期コールバックの成功を表し、その後のアニメーションコマンドの実行完了を保証しません。スキップは購読解除、シーン退出、新しいアニメーションコマンドなどによって発生し、恒久的な購読解除を意味しません。
